title: no sensitive content in photos; the uploader confirms, a report hides

criteria.text: Every photo is checked against known child-abuse hashes, and every post's text and images are screened automatically before they publish (2026-11-12)
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-20] Not built. The AI read runs only after a report (`src/lib/moderation/run-assessment.ts`, `after-report.ts`); nothing screens a post or photo before it is visible, and no hash check exists (grep `hash` over `src/lib/moderation`: none). Cloudflare scanning waits on #641 (F100 criterion 12). #1288 carries the build (hash first, then the Haiku read, shadow first; Path: well-worn, Beta milestone, no `scenario` label because it was filed as a change on 2026-11-12). The scenario's `[replaces 2026-10-06]` ruling overtook "nothing is pre-screened", so this is new work, not a regression.

criteria.text: The post-without-a-Page composer (#1183) asks too: wherever a member posts
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-06, reread 2026-11-20: `PostingSafetyNote` is still absent from `MemberPostComposer.tsx`] `MemberPostComposer` (`src/components/member-posts/MemberPostComposer.tsx`, opened from `/neighbors/new`, merged 2026-11-05 in #1184) shows no safety line: `PostingSafetyNote` is imported by the Page composers, `PageEditor` and `PagePosts` only. It takes no photo, so the per-photo tick does not apply. `[guards F080.5]` pins the older surfaces and cannot see this one. The line itself is the PM's wording and Lost & found is a place to post a lost pet, so the question goes to the PM (#1207, needs-pm).

criteria.text: Where a member posts, one short line encourages good, decent content: a positive reminder, not a list of don'ts; a marked placeholder until the PM's words
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-20] Not built: `src/lib/copy.ts` and the posting surfaces carry no such line (grep `positive reminder`, `good and decent`: only the About and Terms sentences). The criterion says it ships only with the PM's words; #1294 (area:create-posts, Path: new territory) holds the placeholder build and the copy question. Needs the PM, so not `launch-blocking`.
